question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person exhibiting excessive worry about one’s health
solution: The correct answer is: **Hypochondriac** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Hypochondriac **means a state in which a person continuously worries about their health without having any reason to do so. (एक व्यक्ति जो अपने स्वास्थ्य के बारे में असामान्य रूप से चिंतित है) • So, it is clear that '**Hypochondriac**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**A person exhibiting excessive worry about one’s health**' Therefore, the correct answer is option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Intellectual **means a person possessing a highly developed intellect. (अत्यधिक विकसित बुद्धि रखने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Megalomaniac **means a person who has an obsessive desire for power. (एक व्यक्ति जिसे सत्ता की जुनूनी इच्छा है) • **Expert **means a person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area. (एक व्यक्ति जो किसी विशेष क्षेत्र के बारे में बहुत जानकार या कुशल है) 32:Ta3b, The correct answer is: **work hard to**
